# gravity_api_token (Resource)

API token for a Gravity user. The key is generated by the server and can only be read at creation time, so importing a token recovers the user it belongs to but not the key itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gravity_user" "automation" {
  username = "automation"
  permissions = jsonencode([
    {
      path    = "/api/v1/dns/*"
      methods = ["GET", "POST", "DELETE"]
    }
  ])
}

resource "gravity_api_token" "automation" {
  username = gravity_user.automation.username
}

output "automation_token" {
  value     = gravity_api_token.automation.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) User the token authenticates as.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Token used to authenticate against the API. Generated.
